import { bsInputBar } from "./bsui_widgets.js"
import { SuperParserFetcher } from "./superParserFetcher.js";

superBCV = new SuperParserFetcher(); // instance of singleton parser

viewof refInput2 = {
  const bsgroup = new bsInputBar({
    prefixHTML: "<i class='bi bi-book'></i>",
    placeholder:  "Here Bible Reference…",
//    transform: x => x,     // <---- HERE
    transform:  superBCV.parse_inspect,     // <---- HERE
//    fetcher: superBCV.fetchPassage,
    fetcher: superBCV.fetch_ready,
//    fetcher: superBCV.fetch,
    parsingInspector: superBCV.parsingInspector,
//    addLabel: "Add",
    resetLabel: "RAZ"
//    clipLabel: "CLIP"
  }).node();

  return bsgroup;
}
